name: dock
author: CVER Inc.
stores: browser sessionStorage — only for an item set to open once per visit (data-auto-open), and only once it has opened: the key dc-dock:<name> (or dc-dock:<corner>:<label> for an item without data-open-on-hash) holding "opened", so it does not open again for the rest of that tab's visit. Nothing about the visitor, nothing sent anywhere
without: requires nothing and calls nothing. Without the script the element stays exactly as authored — the documented embed carries `hidden`, so nothing shows; without `hidden` the owner's own markup shows in place, unstyled by this coral.
